PILLAR 01 / 3 The Diagnosis Eight vendors. Twelve invoices. One job. 01 Guard Company Silo 02 Camera Vendor Silo 03 Access Control Silo 04 Remote Monitoring Silo 05 Patrol Service Silo 06 Investigations Silo 07 Some New AI Tool Silo 08 Emergency Phones Silo Your guard company can't see your cameras. Your camera company can't dispatch your guards. Your AI vendor can't hear your radios. Your access control runs on a different login. Every one of them sends you a separate invoice. None of them gets called at 3 a.m. when something happens. You do. The CISO down the hall consolidated to one Managed Service Provider twenty years ago. You're still running a relay race. Why? 100M+ Cameras sold across this country. Almost none actively monitored. 90% Of alarms and alerts: false . Dashboards producing noise instead of answers. 100–400% Guard workforce turnover. Cannot verify rounds. Cannot verify presence . 8–12 Vendors the average CSO manages. None accountable to each other. Right Now, At Your Location What keeps you up at night? Retail 22:14 LOCAL Parking Lot — Big Box Two cars circling for forty minutes. Your overnight guard hasn't done a perimeter sweep in three hours. Camera 7 is pointed at a wall. A shopper just called 911 from their car. You'll hear about it on the news . Industrial 03:11 LOCAL Storage Yard — Fenceline The motion sensor on the east fence has tripped eleven times tonight. Your monitoring company stopped calling after the fourth false alarm. Two thousand pounds of copper just walked out the gate. You won't know until inventory Monday . Healthcare 02:47 LOCAL Hospital — ED Entrance A man with no badge walked past the lobby desk fourteen minutes ago. Your guard was on a break. He's now somewhere in the building with your staff and your patients. No one is looking for him . Education 13:32 LOCAL School — Side Entrance The exterior door propped open with a brick — again. The vendor who installed your camera system says it's working. The vendor who installed your access control says it's working. Both invoices say the same thing: not my problem . This is not a technology problem. It is an accountability vacuum . And it is what we built Knightscope to end. The Answer One provider. One contract. One throat to choke. Autonomous machines that patrol. Devices that detect. Software that watches. Licensed agents trained to respond. All on one integrated managed platform. All accountable to one ops team. All a single invoice. The Four Pillars Pillar 01 Auto-resolve the noise. AI agents and autonomous machines clear the routine. Your operators stop chasing shadows and start doing the job they trained for. Your headcount stays flat. Your coverage becomes a force multiplier. Pillar 02 See everything. Be everywhere. A live digital twin. Eyes everywhere, blind spots nowhere — delivered through Signals. Your incident response time collapses. Your insurance carrier finally has something to underwrite against — with real evidence, in three dimensions. Pillar 03 Augment the humans. The Augmented Security Agent. Licensed. Highly trained. Armed and unarmed. The remote operations team directly in their ear. Your turnover stops being your problem. Your guards stop being a liability and become an elite force the nation deserves. Pillar 04 Federal-grade everything. Hardware. Software. Humans. Every component engineered to U.S. federal cybersecurity standards. End to end. Targeting FedRAMP High and DoD Impact Level 5, in partnership with Palantir FedStart. The legacy guard companies cannot credibly claim it. We can — because we build it, we run it, and we are accountable for it. The Competitive Edge Old guard staffing companies can't . New tech vendors don't . Knightscope will . Proven in the Field Fewer incidents. Real arrests. No names. 20→1 Security incidents a month at a commercial site — cut to one for the entire year. Zero Vehicle break-ins in ten months, down from one to two every week. Top 10 A community that ranked top-three for 911 calls dropped out of the top ten. Across retail lots, hospital campuses, residential communities, casinos, and utility sites, Knightscope deployments have cut crime and nuisance activity — sometimes to zero — and delivered the eye-level, time-stamped evidence that lets police identify suspects, secure confessions, and make arrests. We don't trade on logos. We trade on receipts. The Receipts Trust, but verify. Finally, you can do both. Physical security has run on the honor system for thirty years. You paid for patrols. You hoped they happened. We publish the receipts. Autonomously. Every patrol logged. Every sensor check timestamped. Every escalation recorded. Every AI decision exported. Audit-grade evidence — available the moment your CFO, your auditor, your insurance carrier, or your board asks for it. “Your Honor — here is the scene of the crime. In three dimensions. From any angle the court requires.” What federal-grade forensics and ground truth sounds like — and looks like.
